facts: Push On British Standard Pipe Parallel (BSPP)
The BSPP (parallel) male will mate with a BSPP (parallel) female or a female port. The BSPP male has straight threads and a 30° seat. The BSPP female has straight threads and a 30° seat.
The female swivel BSPP has a tapered nose which seals on the cone seat of the male.

The BSPP (parallel) connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPSM connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPSM threads.
Push On National Pipe Tapered Fuel (NPTF)
The NPTF male will mate with the NPTF, NPSF or NPSM female.
The NPTF male has tapered threads and a 30° inverted seat.
The NPTF female has tapered threads and no seat. Sealing occurs through thread deformation.
The NPTF connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, BSPT connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes. Also, the thread angle is 60°, compared to the 55° angle of BSPT threads.

facts: Push On British Standard Pipe Parallel (BSPP)
The BSPP (parallel) male will mate with a BSPP (parallel) female or a female port. The BSPP male has straight threads and a 30° seat. The BSPP female has straight threads and a 30° seat.
The female swivel BSPP has a tapered nose which seals on the cone seat of the male.

The BSPP (parallel) connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPSM connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPSM threads.

facts: The BSPP (parallel) male will mate with a BSPP (parallel) female or a female port. The BSPP male has straight threads and a 30° seat. The BSPP female has straight threads and a 30° seat.
The female swivel BSPP has a tapered nose which seals on the cone seat of the male.

The BSPP (parallel) connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPSM connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPSM threads.
The BSPT (tapered) male will mate with a BSPT (tapered) female, or a BSPP (parallel) female.
The NPTF male will mate with the NPTF, NPSF or NPSM female.

The NPTF connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the BSPT connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes. Also, the thread angle is 60° instead of the 55° angle found on BSPT threads.
Standard SAE J1453 O-Ring Face Seal (ORFS)

facts: The BSPP (parallel) male will mate with a BSPP (parallel) female or a female port. The BSPP male has straight threads and a 30° seat. The BSPP female has straight threads and a 30° seat.
The female swivel BSPP has a tapered nose which seals on the cone seat of the male.

The BSPP (parallel) connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPSM connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPSM threads.

ru.description: Стандартные DIN 2353 / 3865 24° систематизирует изделия и соединения в портфеле Transfer Oil для фитингов по их технической структуре. Технические сведения приведены вместе с данными, извлечёнными из официального источника производителя. При окончательном выборе необходимо совместно учитывать давление, температуру, рабочую среду, стандарт соединения и условия эксплуатации.
benefits: Техническая поддержка выбора по условиям работы
applications: Рукавные сборки с подтверждёнными условиями работы

ar.title: قياسي DIN 2353 / 3865 24°
ar.summary: تنظم صفحة قياسي DIN 2353 / 3865 24° خيارات المنتجات والتوصيلات في مجموعة Transfer Oil الخاصة بـالوصلات وفق بنيتها الفنية.
ar.description: تنظم صفحة قياسي DIN 2353 / 3865 24° خيارات المنتجات والتوصيلات في مجموعة Transfer Oil الخاصة بـالوصلات وفق بنيتها الفنية. تُعرض التفاصيل الفنية مع البيانات المستخرجة من المصدر الرسمي للشركة المصنّعة. يجب أن يراعي الاختيار النهائي الضغط ودرجة الحرارة ونوع المائع ومعيار التوصيل وبيئة التشغيل معاً.

applications: تجميعات خراطيم بظروف تشغيل متحقق منها

facts: The BSPP (parallel) male will mate with a BSPP (parallel) female or a female port. The BSPP male has straight threads and a 30° seat. The BSPP female has straight threads and a 30° seat.
The female swivel BSPP has a tapered nose which seals on the cone seat of the male.

The BSPP (parallel) connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPSM connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPSM threads.
The BSPT (tapered) male will mate with a BSPT (tapered) female, or a BSPP (parallel) female.

The BSPT male has tapered threads. When mating with either the BSPT (tapered) female or the BSPP (parallel) female port, the seal is made on the threads accomplished by thread distortion. A thread sealant is recommended.

The BSPT connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPT connector. The thread pitch is different in most cases, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPT threads.
The NPTF male will mate with the NPTF, NPSF or NPSM female.

The NPTF connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the BSPT connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes. Also, the thread angle is 60° instead of the 55° angle found on BSPT threads.

facts: The BSPP (parallel) male will mate with a BSPP (parallel) female or a female port. The BSPP male has straight threads and a 30° seat. The BSPP female has straight threads and a 30° seat.
The female swivel BSPP has a tapered nose which seals on the cone seat of the male.

The BSPP (parallel) connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPSM connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPSM threads.
The BSPT (tapered) male will mate with a BSPT (tapered) female, or a BSPP (parallel) female.

The BSPT male has tapered threads. When mating with either the BSPT (tapered) female or the BSPP (parallel) female port, the seal is made on the threads accomplished by thread distortion. A thread sealant is recommended.

The BSPT connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPT connector. The thread pitch is different in most cases, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPT threads.
The NPTF male will mate with the NPTF, NPSF or NPSM female.

The NPTF connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the BSPT connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes. Also, the thread angle is 60° instead of the 55° angle found on BSPT threads.
VHP SAE J1453 O-Ring Face Seal (ORFS)
SAE J514 Straight Thread O-Ring Boss (ORB)

facts: The BSPP (parallel) male will mate with a BSPP (parallel) female or a female port. The BSPP male has straight threads and a 30° seat. The BSPP female has straight threads and a 30° seat.
The female swivel BSPP has a tapered nose which seals on the cone seat of the male.

The BSPP (parallel) connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the NPSM connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes, and the thread angle is 55° instead of the 60° angle found on NPSM threads.

facts: The NPTF male will mate with the NPTF, NPSF or NPSM female.

The NPTF connector is similar to, but not interchangeable with, the BSPT connector. The thread pitch is different in most sizes. Also, the thread angle is 60° instead of the 55° angle found on BSPT threads.

ru.description: Промышленная автоматизация систематизирует изделия и соединения в портфеле Transfer Oil для промышленных решений по их технической структуре. Технические сведения приведены вместе с данными, извлечёнными из официального источника производителя. При окончательном выборе необходимо совместно учитывать давление, температуру, рабочую среду, стандарт соединения и условия эксплуатации.
benefits: Техническая поддержка выбора по условиям работы
applications: Рукавные сборки с подтверждёнными условиями работы
